What We Install

Built for every space

We supply and install premium glass and balustrade systems for residential estates, new builds, and commercial developments throughout Gauteng.



Request a Quote
01

Frameless Glass Balustrades

Uninterrupted views with structural toughened glass. The pinnacle of modern balcony and mezzanine design.

↗
02

Stainless Steel Balustrades

Grade 316 brushed or mirror-finish steel with horizontal rod infills or glass panels. Built to last a lifetime.

↗
03

Post Glass Balustrades

Glass panels between steel or aluminium posts — versatile for balconies, pool surrounds, and terraces.

↗
04

Powder Coated Aluminium

Lightweight, rust-free aluminium systems in any powder coat colour to match your architecture precisely.

↗
05

Staircase Railings

Interior and exterior staircases finished in glass, steel, or aluminium. Every handrail is custom fabricated.

↗
06

Commercial Installs

Large-scale balustrade projects for developers and contractors. We deliver on time, on spec, every time.

◆

Gauteng-Based, Site-Ready
